title: Energy Shield
text:
Energy Shield (abbreviated as ES) is one of the three core defences that can be found on equipment. It is associated with intelligence and acts as an additional hit points on top of life that recharges over time if the defender does not lose energy shield or life for a short duration. Bleeding and poison damage bypasses energy shield to damage life directly, while chaos damage deals twice as much damage against energy shield.


== Mechanics ==


=== Damage mitigation ===
Energy shield protects life by being depleted first before taking damage to life. 
The damage inflicted on Energy Shield is calculated after all damage mitigation factors, such as physical or elemental resistances, have been taken into account.
Damage from Bleeding and Poison bypass energy shield, damaging life directly. Certain items may also cause damage to bypass energy shield.
Chaos damage removes twice as much energy shield as other damage types. This does not affect the overall damage dealt. In the case that Chaos Damage deals damage to both Energy Shield and Life (or Mana) in a single instance of damage, it will not affect the Life or Mana removed.


=== Recharge ===

If energy shield is not at full and life or energy shield have not been lost for a short delay (also known as "start of Energy Shield Recharge"), it will begin to recharge 12.5% of maximum energy shield per second. Energy shield recharge is considered a form of recovery, but it is not regeneration. Any damage taken to Life or ES will interrupt recharge, restarting the delay timer.
Other forms of recovery do not interact with recharge.

Life recharges at a rate of 12.5% of maximum life with a 4 second recharge delay, same as ES recharge. Modifiers to ES recharge rate and delay will also affect life recharge.


==== Start of Energy shield Recharge ====

Energy shield will start recharging if the character does not take any damage for a certain period of time. By default, this time is 4 seconds. It can be reduced with #% faster start of Energy Shield Recharge modifiers from passive skills and equipment. 
Let r be the sum of  #% faster start of Energy Shield Recharge modifiers (as a percentage). The delay period in seconds is given by:

  
    
      
        Delay Period
      
      =
      
        
          400
          
            100
            +
            r
          
        
      
    
    \color [rgb]{0.6392156862745098,0.5529411764705883,0.42745098039215684}{\text{Delay Period}}={400 \over 100+r}
  

For example, having 100% faster start of Energy Shield Recharge results in a delay period of 400/200 = 2 seconds.

== Passive skills ==
There are passive skills that grant energy shield bonuses.


=== Base energy shield ===
These passive skills grant additional base maximum energy shield.


=== Maximum energy shield ===
These passive skills grant increases or reductions to maximum energy shield.


=== Energy shield recharge rate ===
These passive skills grant increased rate of energy shield recharge.


=== Energy shield recharge delay ===
These passive skill grants faster or slower start of energy shield recharge.


=== Stun/ailment threshold ===
These passive skill grants stun or ailment threshold based on maximum energy shield.
